g.text: py-app-poster-pr-mandelapark | type poster | trim 700 x 1000 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Bron: PR_WTC_Poster.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC); bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 700 x 1000 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 706 x 1006 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; label-pr = P+R; location-line-1 = Parking; location-line-2 = Mandelapark; price = €6; price-suffix = ,-; label = per dag; url-bold = voordelig; url-regular = parkeren.nl

700 x 1000 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim, RGB ICC). Navy field: one source path of 847 x 1127 mm (-117 / -177 to 730 / 949.5) of which only the part on the page is visible: the top and the sides run off the page, the lower left is cut by an arc, white paper below it up to x 349, a vertical edge and a pointed bottom right. The template rebuilds

the visible part as a path (source path intersected with the page plus 3 mm bleed with pathops, as in the tariff panel). The reference also keeps a navy rectangle (70.8 to 644.1 x 112.5 to 383.2 mm, #233A89 against the field #23398E) that is faintly visible in the source as a slightly different blue; it is a leftover and is not in the template. P+R symbol:
py-comp-symbol-pr scaled 5.964x at 100.0 / 59.8 mm, live label P+R Ubuntu Bold 270.4 mm white.
